$comment: Figma layer path (as in spec.json) -> element inside the entry's target (.ds-slider) and how to read it.

root.$why: Figma's root lays out one child (the track); its gap does not apply.

Slider.$why: The track is a plain box in code (no auto-layout); its radius is radius-full (9999 px), which draws the same 4 px pill as Figma's 16.

control.$why: The fill inherits the track's full radius.

Thumb.$why: The stroke outside is the thumb's first box-shadow; radius-full draws the same circle as Figma's 16.
